changeOrders.current: Language toggle is missing from header (0 matches for button#lang-toggle). Header contains only nav links 'WANAUME', 'WANAWAKE', and 'MPYA'.
changeOrders.desired: Header must include a SW/EN language toggle on the right side using <button id="lang-toggle">SW | EN</button> with touch target dimensions ≥ 44×44 px, visible across 375px, 768px, and 1280px viewports.
changeOrders.visionNote: Bilingual support (Swahili/English) is crucial for local market trust and usability in Dar es Salaam.

changeOrders.current: Logo, header navigation, hero heading h1, card prices, and footer are rendered with fontFamily=Courier New.
changeOrders.desired: Global typography must use Inter or system sans-serif ONLY. Remove Courier New and all monospace font declarations completely from header, hero, price tags, cards, and footer.
changeOrders.visionNote: A clean sans-serif stack preserves the night-time premium streetwear tone without defaulting to a code-editor aesthetic.

changeOrders.current: Crimson text rgb(225, 29, 72) (#E11D48) on surface rgb(20, 20, 22) (#141416) yields a contrast ratio of 3.92:1, failing WCAG AA 4.5:1 minimum.
changeOrders.desired: Restrict #E11D48 strictly to primary CTA button backgrounds (with white text #FFFFFF). Set card titles and primary body text to #F5F5F5 and secondary metadata/prices to high-contrast colors (e.g., #F5F5F5 or #A1A1AA) on surface #141416, ensuring contrast ratio ≥ 4.5:1.
changeOrders.visionNote: Ensures WCAG AA compliance while maintaining a high-contrast, calm night-time aesthetic.

changeOrders.current: Nav link anchors have a rendered height of only 15px (68.06x15, 77.78x15, 38.89x15).
changeOrders.desired: Increase header nav link touch targets to achieve computed touch dimensions of min-height ≥ 44px and min-width ≥ 44px (e.g., via inline-flex and vertical padding within 64px header).
changeOrders.visionNote: Guarantees reliable, effortless tapping across desktop and mobile devices.

changeOrders.current: No fixed mobile order bar exists at viewport width 375px.
changeOrders.desired: Implement a fixed bottom bar at viewport width <768px (e.g., id="whatsapp-sticky-bar") containing one primary CTA 'Agiza kwa WhatsApp' (height ≥48px, background #E11D48, text #FFFFFF, Inter, sentence case) opening wa.me with product details; hidden at ≥768px.
changeOrders.visionNote: Drives mobile conversion on WhatsApp, the primary order mechanism in Dar es Salaam.

changeOrders.current: Product grid renders 5 columns at 1280px viewport.
changeOrders.desired: Enforce a strict 4-column product grid at 1280px desktop breakpoint using grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)) (or lg:grid-cols-4).
changeOrders.visionNote: Maintains the premium spacing and rhythmic grid layout defined in A3.
